body:
@stuartwdouglas I chased down the issue to an entity to persistence unit cache we build inside a build step, and set inside a static field from a recorder. This works well in 1.13 but didn't work anymore in 2.0. I know there was some class loader changes can this been the cause ?
The path that didn't work anymore is:
- From the build step to the recorder: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/extensions/panache/hibernate-orm-panache-kotlin/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/hibernate/orm/panache/kotlin/deployment/KotlinPanacheResourceProcessor.java#L159
- From the recorder to the use site: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/extensions/panache/hibernate-orm-panache-kotlin/runtime/src/main/kotlin/io/quarkus/hibernate/orm/panache/kotlin/runtime/PanacheKotlinHibernateOrmRecorder.kt#L9
- The use site: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/extensions/panache/hibernate-orm-panache-common/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/hibernate/orm/panache/common/runtime/AbstractJpaOperations.java#L33

The cache is correctly created and set, but at runtime the hashmap is empty but in 1.13 is was correctly populated.

issue.title: Disallow public final methods on recorders
issue.body:
These can cause problems as the results silently won't be recorded.

This is potentially a breaking change, although I don't think it should
cause issues in practice, as there is no real use case for final public
recorder methods.
